activation.definition: % of cohort GURU (role=GURU, onboarded=true, non-founder for organic) with >=1 class (Group.teacherId).

operationalClassrooms.definition: Group where X AND Y AND Z over same trailing-30d WIB window (X=artifact, Y=>=3 distinct active students, Z=student Z-evidence).
operationalClassrooms.X: Penugasan, QuizAssignment, MateriKirim, Pengumuman (teacher-owned for group), OR >=1 StudentKarya into the group by a member
operationalClassrooms.Y: >=3 distinct GroupMember.userId each with Z evidence (studentFloor=3, target=5)
operationalClassrooms.Z: XPTransaction, QuizSubmission, UserUnitProgress, ProgresKompetensi, StudentKarya (NEVER legacy User.xp)
